StatementClassification.description:
Per-statement provenance class (decision Q1c/Q3b).

The gate blocks ``NEW_AI_DIAGNOSIS``. ``SOURCE_RECORD_DIAGNOSIS`` is a
diagnosis already in the user's records (allowed, attributed), distinct from
a *new* AI-generated diagnostic label (blocked).

Public recipient read of a shared packet. Returns 404 for any unknown,
revoked, expired, or passcode-failing link (no information leak).

patch.description:
Toggle statement inclusion. Deselected statements are kept and marked,
never silently dropped (decision: deselection visibility).

post.description:
Export a copy. This is a distinct, clearly-warned state from a controlled
link share: an exported copy cannot be recalled.

get.description:
Enumerate the contexts the actor can act in, personal pinned first.

Fail-closed for *others'* workspaces (only persisted memberships are returned),
but fail-open for the caller's *own* personal surface: if the actor has no
persisted personal workspace yet (e.g. a dev principal that predates onboarding),
a synthetic personal entry is returned so the personal-first default always holds.

schema.title: Response List Workspaces V2 Workspaces Get
